edge_mean_length: sum of covalent radii, shared and fixed across all tree models
primary: All four methods retrained3000 shared FM steps from one warm decoder per seed. Learned tree vs local learned and no-block fixed; fixed tree affinities isolate added affinity learning. Fresh draws on a reused12-composition monomer development panel.
mechanism: Recompute weighted spanning-tree edge marginals from current geometry and learned invariant features at every denoiser call; feed them to a zero-initialized edge residual adapter. No sampled source tree is supplied to the field.
prior_training: No source adaptation; all methods share exactly the fixed shell source and radial laws.
claim_boundary: Matrix-tree structured attention and molecular graph attention are established. The candidate is state-dependent globally connected structure inference inside a bond-free molecular flow, whose useful incremental value is unproved.
molecular_energy_gate: No physical queries in this bounded architecture test.
target_alignment_reason: The previous utility source and static source-tree conditioning pilots fail to establish improvement. This new hypothesis changes the flow information at each current geometry, not the source distribution. It does not assume the old failure has a uniquely proven cause.
selection: First3128 connected/nonoverlapping TRAIN rows under a new seeded permutation, excluding all listed evaluation/candidate compositions; first3000 shared FM fit. Existing fixed-decoder references cannot replace this newly matched no-block baseline.
role: Prospective method comparison on reused development compositions, no new quantum labels or energy-law claim
pilot_gate: Tree-learned graph pass point gain over local-learned and fixed in both seeds, pooled paired95 lower bounds positive over both, no >2pp loss in distinct connectivity per attempt against fixed. Report fixed-tree comparison separately: no claim for learned affinities unless they add value.
uncertainty: Paired draws conditional on12 reused monomer compositions plus descriptive size-stratified composition bootstrap; no unseen model-seed population or confirmatory claim.
fail_rule: No per-seed model choice, post hoc reward/filter change or optimizer/width/lr sweep on these outcomes. A failed gate remains a failed gate.
numerical_tree_rule: After subtracting max log weight, floor off-diagonal relative weights at1e-8 in both tree and local rules. No Laplacian diagonal ridge; marginals remain for a spanning-tree law with the declared floored weights.
